chunks: What al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from al-Nadr, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Zurarah, from 'Umar ibn Hanzalah, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

The salat of supererogatory prayer on Friday, if you wish, may be performed from the beginning of the day; and whatever you intend to perform after Jumu'ah, then if you wish, you may advance it and perform it from the beginning of the day, at whatever part of the day you wish, before the sun declines.

key_terms.بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ: after Jumu'ah, meaning the prayers one planned for after the Friday prayer
key_terms.تَزُولَ الشَّمْسُ: the sun declines from its zenith, i.e. the time of zawal
key_terms.صَلَاةُ: salat (prayer), here referring to ritual prayer
key_terms.عَجَّلْتَهُ: you advance it, meaning you perform it earlier than its later expected time
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ: the day of Friday, specifically in the context of Jumu'ah rulings

ai.seo_question: Can the supererogatory prayers of Friday be performed before noon?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding supererogatory salat on Friday. It indicates that the nawafil associated with the day of Jumu'ah may be advanced and performed before zawal, from the early part of the day.
